2000081/1.0:20:
As Commander of House Nouin's military forces, he is a tough warrior. He is Yuwel's older brother and, though he never expressed it, was often concerned by his younger brother's dedication to his ideals.

This changed when his brother returned to the Farlands having matured over the years. He agreed to cooperate with the House of Tris in support of the re-establishment of the Swallow Knights.

5000193/4.0:20:
Working in secret, a Star Augur by the name of Procheon orchestrated an attack on the Kaleidoscope's 50th Anniversary celebration.

He was assisted by a man named Orgus Oxtan, who helped him steal the Anti-Observer and lead a serpent into the Kaleidoscope. A group of adventurers swiftly handled the incident, preventing the Oxtans from being implicated on a wide-scale. Procheon's true intentions were never uncovered.

5000193/5.0:20:
The discovery of a secret facility in Oxtan territory brought to light the involvement of Star Augurs in the latest monster assault of the Farlands. This facility provided funding and equipment for them, as well as conducted secret research on the tentacled monsters thought to be the source of this latest monster incident.

Not only were the Oxtans implicated in the matter, but the Kweturs from which their House originally branched as well. The Kweturs deny any involvement, but Vyron, having investigated the Kweturs since the assassination of Etheria, believes the two Houses are conspiring together in secret.

5000208/4.0:20:
As a result of the latest monster assault, there have been significant changes in the standings of many successors, which has drawn the attention of even the general populace.

Despite these changes, the fourteenth in line for throne is still completely out of the running.

5000211/2.0:20:
When the monster outbreak occurred, the House of Tris took up the position that it was not their place to impede the duties of another House. This changed after they received a formal request from Yuwel Nouin, who gave them enough pretext to mobilize the lord of Tris and his personal troops.

Despite typically avoiding any sort of political entanglements, things shifted after the incident. Rumor has it that Ciel Tris has finally cast his lot in support of a successor to the throne.

5000212/3.0:20:
During the latest monster outbreak, the Kweturs and Oxtans jointly refused the Swes' plan to seek aid from Palpebra.

It was later revealed that the Kweturs had been involved with activities at a secret monster research facility in Oxtan territory. They defended themselves by saying the research was for dealing with the monster problem, and that the Oxtans had taken their work too far without their permission.

Although a thorough investigation found no evidence to refute these claims, the House of Kwetur lost much of their influence within the kingdom.

5000216/2.0:20:
The man who orchestrated the attack on the Kaleidoscope's 50th anniversary and called down the dragons was Orgus of House Oxtan.

During an interrogation, Orgus revealed the involvement of a Star Augur named Procheon and implied that the Kweturs had a hand in things. The Farlands demanded he be extradited before the interrogation was completed.

All of Orgus' statements were hidden away, never to be seen by the public. The man himself is reportedly still being confined within the kingdom.

5000216/3.0:20:
During the latest monster outbreak, the Oxtans joined the Kweturs in rejecting assistance from Palpebra. A secret monster research lab was discovered in Oxtan territory in the midst of the chaos.

It was an operation meant to provide funds and facilities for a cult known as the Star Augurs. The House of Oxtan maintains that the facility was meant to help resolve the incident, while the Kweturs deny any knowledge of what went on. Following this incident, both families continue to face intense scrutiny from the other Houses.

As relations with the Kweturs sour, the House's reputation continues to plummet.

5000217/2.0:20:
Tasked with maintaining public order, the House of Nouin was originally handling the monster outbreak on their own. As the threat grew, they gradually began to fall behind in their duty.

Political troubles kept the Nouins from joining forces with the House of Tris until the unexpected return of Yuwel, who was presumed missing. The situation turned for the better, and the House of Nouin gained the trust of the people for their efforts in quelling the outbreak.

Date: **/**. Weather Conditions: Clear
Performed an initial activation on the target golem using the newly contrived procedure. Subject did not respond well and began to exhibit unintended behavior. Thankfully, a (rather petite) wind-magic using professor was in the vicinity, and the situation was taken care of before any major damage was done. The professors gave me hell for that one. Promising that my next experiment would not end in failure only seemed to make them angrier. Reasons unclear.

Date: **/**. Weather Conditions: Overcast
Another one went haywire—and I even went and used a brand new reactor core this time! Thankfully Cipher's ice magic helped the golem cool down, so to speak. No major damage, though parts of the Academy are still rather... frosty. But, I have great news: this malfunction was NOT caused by the same thing as the last one. Splendid! Well, except for the fact that the professors scolded me to no end. Graaaaaagh.

- Excerpts of a Certain Student's Diary

1213013/2.0:20:
For a long time, she spent her days holding back tears and forcing a smile. When the dam finally broke, she found herself crying whenever the urge hit.

Thinking back, she felt frustrated with the way everything had gone. The people she looked up to were so kind, but when they needed help the most, she could do nothing but shed tears. That was why, from then on, she wiped her eyes dry and learned to fight. She would reach out and grab destiny with her own hands.

Ayumu Nagihara won't be the only hero around the block anymore.
